claims.statement: The @tingting/shared package exposes constants/index.ts (TS enums + Vietnamese *_LABELS Record maps) and schemas/index.ts (Zod schemas + re-exported z.infer input types); every enum has a paired *_LABELS Record so the UI never hardcodes display strings.

Major enums include TripStatus (CREATED, IN_TRANSIT, COMPLETED, LOCKED, CANCELED), FuelMode (AUTO, FLAT_RATE), LoadingType (HANG, VO), Role (ADMIN, MANAGER, ACCOUNTANT, DRIVER, FORWARDER), TxnType (16 members including TRIP_REVENUE, PENALTY, UNLOCK_REVERSAL, SERVICE_FEE), TrailerType (20FT, 40FT), truck/trailer/driver/customer status, PenaltyStatus, VehicleComponent, VehicleScheduleKind/Status, TireStatus, AdvanceRequestStatus, AdvanceSettlementStatus, ExpenseEntryStatus, NotificationType, CarrierType (OWN, EXTERNAL), SettlementMethod, ApprovalStatus, DebitNoteMode, TruckCapRole, WorkDayStatus (TRIP_DAY/STANDBY/PERSONAL_LEAVE/WEEKLY_OFF), SalaryConfirmationStatus.

Helper constants include BILLABLE_TRIP_STATUSES = [COMPLETED, LOCKED], FINANCIAL_ROLES / isFinancialRole = [ADMIN, MANAGER, ACCOUNTANT], Casbin resource names (CONFIG, FINANCIAL, REPORTS, DRIVER, SYSTEM, AUTH, TRIPS, CATALOGS, FORWARDER, NOTIFICATIONS, SALARY, TRACKING, TIRES, VEHICLE_SCHEDULES), FORWARDER_EXPENSE_TYPE_DEFAULTS, ANCILLARY_EXPENSE_TYPES, PUSH_RULES, AGENT_ROUTE_KEYS, ACKED_DIRECTIVE_KINDS, and admin API path constants CHATBOT_METRICS_PATHS / LLM_PROVIDERS / LLM_PROVIDER_MODELS / LLM_PROVIDER_LABELS / LLM_SETTINGS_PATHS / GPS_SETTINGS_PATHS / FAQ_ADMIN_PATHS.

Two custom Zod primitives are exported: numericMoney (union of number and string that transforms to a decimal-string with 2dp) and numericDecimal (same shape, higher precision for non-money numerics); major schemas cover Trip, payment/penalty/adjustment, auth, catalogs, suppliers/expenses, vehicle schedules, containers/seals/expenses/instructions, forwarder flow, tires, billing, commission/payout/offset, containers/ports/seals, Bách Khoa GPS, agent/chatbot, and FAQ.

The z.infer pattern is preferred over hand-written interfaces — every schema has a paired `export type XxxInput = z.infer<typeof xxxSchema>` so backend handlers read req.body through xxxSchema.parse() (ZodError → 400 in globalErrorHandler) and use XxxInput for the service signature while the frontend re-imports the same XxxInput for form types.

Module-specific sub-barrels include schemas/agent.ts (agent schemas), schemas/chatbot-metrics.ts (types + paths), schemas/llm-settings.ts (provider list + update schema), schemas/gps-settings.ts (GPS credentials), schemas/app-settings.ts (single-row app settings), and schemas/faq.ts (FAQ admin schemas).
